actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent, biologically interpretable identity: a strong RNA inflammatory/immune program (ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION and IL6/JAK/STAT3 up, SMD ~0.9, q=0.0001; 26/50 Hallmark pathways significant) accompanied by a concordant CNV profile (higher VHL/chr20q, more chr14q and CDKN2A loss, 19/49 continuous features q<0.05). WXS findings are nominal only, but the identity does not depend on them. Membership is structurally compatible: all patients have at least one positive modality, median support is 3 of 5, and the internal SNF probe is non-degenerate with moderate resampling stability (ARI 0.604). Measured technical factors show no significant association after correction, so they do not provide a dominant alternative explanation. Known-label echo is near zero, indicating the set is not recapitulating stage or grade. Structural metrics are weak but positive, and there is no positively supported Split or Merge; retaining C0001 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a coherent identity that mirrors and complements C0001: relative down-regulation of the inflammatory/IL6-JAK-STAT3 program with up-regulation of pancreas beta cells and heme metabolism (SMD ~0.9, q=0.0001), plus a concordant CNV profile (lower VHL/chr20q, less chr14q and CDKN2A loss, 19/49 continuous features q<0.05). WXS enrichment is nominal only and not required for the identity. Membership is structurally compatible: no patient has zero positive modalities, median support is 3 of 5, and the internal SNF probe is non-degenerate with moderate resampling stability (ARI 0.590). No technical variable is significantly associated after correction, so measured technical factors do not dominate the molecular signal. Known-label echo is near zero. Structural separation is weak but positive, and no positively supported Split or Merge exists; retaining C0002 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.
